```{r}
# Values below the LOD / LLOQ without a value (n.d. / n.q.) take part as the lowest ranks (n.d.
# below n.q., tied among themselves) instead of being left out; the test uses the ranks only
rank_y <- function(conc, flag) {
  dplyr::case_when(!is.na(conc) ~ conc, flag %in% "n.d." ~ -2, flag %in% "n.q." ~ -1, TRUE ~ NA_real_)
}
# A median in the n.d. / n.q. values has no value
med <- function(y) {
  if (!any(y < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) return(median(y, na.rm = TRUE))
  m <- unname(stats::quantile(y, 0.5, type = 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (is.na(m) || m < 0) NA_real_ else m
}
cmp_t <- study_long |> filter(Class %in% grp) |>
  mutate(y = rank_y(conc, conc_flag)) |>
  group_by(Feature = feature_name) |>
  filter(mean(status == "Valid") >= 0.5) |>
  summarise(
    med1 = med(y[Class == grp[1]]),
    med2 = med(y[Class == grp[2]]),
    p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(y[Class == grp[1]], y[Class == grp[2]])$p.value, error = \(e) NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Type = "Targeted (concentration)")
# Non-targeted features, all batches together (`drop = FALSE`: also with a single feature)
# (A block of features at a time: no copies of the whole matrix)
keep_f <- unlist(lapply(row_blocks(nrow(nt_m)), function(r) {
  b <- nt_m[r, , drop = FALSE]
  rowSums(!is.na(b)) > 0 & rowMeans(b[, g1 | g2, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.5
}), use.names = FALSE)
nt_m <- nt_m[keep_f, , drop = FALSE]
row_medians <- function(cols) unlist(lapply(row_blocks(nrow(nt_m)), function(r) {
  apply(nt_m[r, cols, drop = FALSE], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
}), use.names = FALSE)
cmp_nt <- tibble(
  Feature = feat$label[match(rownames(nt_m), feat$feature_id)],
  med1 = row_medians(g1),
  med2 = row_medians(g2),
  p = vapply(seq_len(nrow(nt_m)), \(i) tryCatch(wilcox.test(nt_m[i, g1], nt_m[i, g2])$p.value,
                                                 error = \(e) NA_real_), numeric(1)),
  Type = "Non-targeted (intensity)"
)
cmp <- bind_rows(cmp_t, cmp_nt) |>
  mutate(log2fc = log2((med2 + 1e-9) / (med1 + 1e-9)), q = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
         sig = ifelse(q < 0.05, paste(sub(" \\(.*", "", Type), "q < 0.05"), "Not significant"))
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf('<div class="callout-q">%s vs %s: %d of %d targeted compounds and %d of %d non-targeted features differ (q &lt; 0.05).</div>',
            grp[2], grp[1], sum(cmp_t$Feature %in% cmp$Feature[cmp$q < 0.05 & cmp$Type == cmp_t$Type[1]]), nrow(cmp_t),
            sum(cmp$q < 0.05 & cmp$Type == "Non-targeted (intensity)", na.rm = TRUE), nrow(cmp_nt)))
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Fold change vs significance

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.5
if (nrow(cmp) == 0) note("No features to compare.") else {
p_v <- ggplot(cmp, aes(log2fc, -log10(q), text = paste0(Feature, " (", Type, ")<br>log2 FC: ", round(log2fc, 2),
                                                          "<br>q: ", signif(q, 2)))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig, shape = Type), size = 2.2, alpha = .8) +
  # Colour-blind safe (Okabe-Ito)
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Targeted q < 0.05" = show$okabe_ito[["vermillion"]],
                                "Non-targeted q < 0.05" = show$okabe_ito[["blue"]],
                                "Not significant" = "#BDBDBD"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Targeted (concentration)" = 17, "Non-targeted (intensity)" = 16), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = paste0("log2 fold change (", grp[2], " / ", grp[1], ", medians)"), y = "-log10(q) (Wilcoxon, BH)")
# WebGL (scattergl): fast also with tens of thousands of features
plotly::toWebGL(plotly::ggplotly(p_v, tooltip = "text", height = 560))
}
```

### Table

All compared features, the significant ones (q &lt; 0.05) first, and the targeted compounds that were
not tested (a valid concentration in fewer than half of the study samples of the two groups). Choose
*Yes* in the filter of the column **Significant** for the significant features only; **CSV** or
**Copy** gives the rows shown by the filters.

```{r}
# The targeted compounds that were not tested (too few valid concentrations), and those whose test
# gave no p-value
not_tested <- study_long |> filter(Class %in% grp) |> group_by(Feature = feature_name) |>
  summarise(v = mean(status == "Valid"), .groups = "drop") |> filter(v < 0.5)
cmp_all <- bind_rows(cmp, tibble(Feature = not_tested$Feature, Type = rep("Targeted (concentration)", nrow(not_tested)))) |>
  mutate(Significant = factor(case_when(is.na(p) ~ "Not tested", !is.na(q) & q < 0.05 ~ "Yes", TRUE ~ "No"),
                              levels = c("Yes", "No", "Not tested")))
if (nrow(cmp_all) == 0) note("No features to compare.") else
cmp_all |> arrange(Significant, q, Feature) |>
  transmute(Feature, Type = factor(Type), Significant, !!paste("Median", grp[1]) := signif(med1, 3),
            !!paste("Median", grp[2]) := signif(med2, 3),
            `log2 FC` = round(log2fc, 2), p = signif(p, 2), q = signif(q, 2)) |>
  dt()
```
